description_en: Queries information about the Autoscaler configurations of a service
description_zh: 查看服务的自动扩缩配置详情
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-service-auto-scaler --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name echo --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServiceAutoScaler

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the service
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

Behavior.description_en: The additional information about the Autoscaler policy, such as the interval of triggering Autoscaler
Behavior.description_zh: 额外扩缩容策略。例如触发扩缩容前的等待时间

metricName.description_en:
The metric name. Valid values:

QPS

CPU
metricName.description_zh:
指标名称。可能值：
QPS
CPU

service.description_en: The service for which the metric is specified

MaxReplica.description_en: The maximum number of instances in the service

MinReplica.description_en: The minimum number of instances in the service

metricName.description_en:
The metric name. Valid values:

QPS: the queries per second (QPS) for an individual instance.

CPU: the CPU utilization
metricName.description_zh:
指标名称，可能值：
QPS：单实例QPS伸缩阈值。
CPU：CPU利用率阈值

service.description_en: The service for which the metric is specified. If you do not set this parameter, the current service is specified by default
service.description_zh: 指标所属服务，不配置默认为当前服务

threshold.description_en:
The threshold of the metric that triggers auto scaling.

If you set metricName to QPS, scale-out is triggered when the average QPS for a single instance is greater than this threshold.

If you set metricName to CPU, scale-out is triggered when the average CPU utilization for a single instance is greater than this threshold
threshold.description_zh:
触发自动伸缩阈值。
指标名称配置为QPS：当单实例的平均QPS大于该值时会触发扩容。
指标名称配置为CPU：当单实例的平均CPU使用率大于该值时会触发扩容
